name: payment-referrer-unlisted-host-referral
description: Look-alike host notpaypal.com is not a subdomain of paypal.com: with the payment list configured it still classifies as a plain referral.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (WP plugin 1.11.0 parity, issue #43): matching is host-or-subdomain, never substring. Semver: additive opt-in input (minor); no default list ships, so CLASSIFIER_VERSION is unchanged.
